question: If cot B = 9, then what will be the value of sec² B?
solution:
Given:

cot B = 9

Concept used:

1. cosec² θ - cot² θ = 1

2. sin² θ + cos2 θ = 1

3. sin θ = 1/cosec θ

4. cos θ = 1/sec θ

Calculation:

cot B = 9

⇒ cot² B = 81

⇒ 1 + cot2 B = 1 + 81

⇒ cosec² B = 82

⇒ sin² B = 1/82

⇒ 1 - sin² B = 1 - 1/82

⇒ cos² B = 81/82

⇒ sec² B = 82/81

**∴ The value of sec2 B is 82/81.**
